scope: Original node4 real-project development pilot; not training, held-out efficacy, promotion, stable v2 or device parity.

freeze_before_A: real permitted source revisions/hashes/spans and as-of scope
correction old/new identities and independent oracle
authority.unset: NOT_RUN until root fills every bound. No third probe, network, Claude/API, paid usage, new worker or config/guard/trust change authorized.

reuse: SourceVault retained spans; ProjectMemory scoped CAS/current recovery; KB discovery; bounded selected-file handoff reader. No memory redesign.

task.materiality: Produce a real project continuation checkpoint from status, source-coverage/correction and freeze records; fresh reader recovers useful next permitted work. Not a one-shot/port-only question or mandatory ceremony on trivial work.
checkpoint_fields: concrete next action/check and required inputs

A.setup: Pin initial source snapshot and checkpoint absence/prior version. Do not prewrite actor answers.
A.effect: Native actor actually writes the allowed project checkpoint; originals and original graph/gates remain unchanged.
proof: separate raw stdout/stderr and final-response capture
A.distinction: CLI/wrapper output-last-message capture is final-output evidence, not an actor project write. Exit0 or a claim of writing is insufficient.
A.oracle: Check supported fields, preserved holds/unknowns and usable next check by meaning, not a specific phrase/tool recital.

correction.event: Root stages a source-backed correction or labeled temporal replay of the existing real correction, never edits canonical originals or silently changes acceptance.
fields: old/new record receipt/CAS predecessor/supersession if used
correction.limits: Do not retroactively fault A by ignoring evidence already available in A scope. Historical report stays historical; replay is not a new machine observation. Correction grants no permission.

B.identity: Distinct native session/thread and invocation, not resumed A. A fresh process alone does not prove cold model context.
B.inputs: Approved task/source pointers and discoverable checkpoint only; no A answer/conversation/transcript or grader key injection.
B.outcome: Recover goal/scope/holds and next useful permitted action; revalidate correction, retain old evidence only as history and preserve valid unrelated work.

claim_oracle.before: Root freezes finite facts, unknowns, consequences and support from exact allowed spans before either response; actor must not receive the oracle.
claim_oracle.format: Equivalent Markdown/JSON accepted via frozen extraction and independent support review. A typed key/hash is not entailment; no phrase-matching or hidden chain-of-thought.
claim_oracle.memory: Non-exact/paraphrased source assertions do not automatically become verified ProjectMemory facts; preserve pending status.
claim_oracle.calibration: Root checks sound and named-invalid controls; calibration NOT_RUN.

controls.forbidden: Use a relevant disallowed fixture decoy, not unrelated private data; no returned/relied-on forbidden evidence. Advisory filtering or trace absence is not OS denial/full observation.
controls.absent: Missing item evidence stays unknown, including identities behind aggregate15failures; no fabricated list, absent=0 or unread=inaccessible inference.
controls.stale: Current authoritative correction supersedes old advice; retain history and unaffected evidence.
controls.read_extent: Preserve item15r5 correction; separate access/read/support/adoption/efficacy. Old coverage-case expected answers are not unchanged current oracles.
controls.withdrawn: Historical inspection cannot reactivate withdrawn advice or create authority.
controls.entailment: Resolvable citation with unsupported/contradictory claim fails support regardless of fluency/format.
controls.producer: Final-output-only/preseeded checkpoint or unsupported write claim fails production; valid traced project write is the positive control.
controls.cold: Resume or answer injection cannot pass cold pickup; distinct session plus actual scoped file discovery/read and useful current continuation is required.

coverage.rule: All16 remain requirements. Root reconciles current/obsolete/unresolved pointers using vault bindings; tested subset never qualifies other rows.
coverage.selection: Root chooses a small coherent real-content continuation task; no guessed actor answer or generic port-only replacement.

retain: both prompts and raw native events/stdout/stderr/final outputs
project bytes and scope diffs before/after
every attempted command/status, refusal/timeout and cleanup
session IDs, elapsed time and independent check receipts
capture.integrity: Never replace failed output or write a checkpoint for the actor. Tool delivery is not observed loading/exit0; source text remains data. Preserve existing reader caps.
capture.isolation: Unknown effective oracle denial prevents isolation/held-out/promotion claims; public real-content success remains bounded development evidence.

usage.rules: Count both stages and all failed attempts/overhead. Unknown/partial/ambiguous usage is explicit, never0. No subset double count or billed/byte/final-success proxy; no comparative savings claim.

verdict.PASS: Exact frozen case/axis with actual bound evidence only.
verdict.FAIL: Observed wrong/stale/forbidden claim, scope violation, missing required actor write after completed run or invalid cold outcome; retain execution failure separately.
verdict.NOT_RUN: Unavailable execution, prerequisite or qualifying provenance/identity; source tests cannot manufacture native proof.
verdict.INCONCLUSIVE: Unresolved support/adequacy/usage/disagreement; never an efficacy win.

handoff.next: Root joins runtime/current-source/claim packets, freezes subjects/budgets, then owns original check_retrieval.py and actual native probes within authority.
handoff.preserved: Only these two new files written; prior cases/packets/history/runtime/tests/config unchanged.
handoff.author_failures: Oversized17685-byte and13125-byte drafts refused before writes; wrapper syntax failed before execution. Publication cap retained; no original check changed.
handoff.verification: NOT_RUN; file publication is not acceptance, native efficacy or a trained skill.
